assumptions: Stop is interpreted as remaining stopped with max_speed 0.05 continuously for 1000 ms inside stop_zone; the statute states 'shall stop' with no duration.

Only the marked limit-line branch is checked; the 'otherwise before entering the crosswalk' and 'entrance to the intersecting roadway' alternatives have no provided zones or lines and are not checked.
Vehicles that never cross the stop_line pass vacuously; a stop is required only when crossing occurs.
Anchor center is used because boxes are top-down vehicles whose centre is metric position while bottom_center is only the downstream AABB edge.
Inbound approach motion (+y) is encoded as direction to_right per the stop_line definition.
Presence of a stop sign and intersection entrance is assumed from camera placement; every tracked vehicle is treated as approaching the sign.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the stop line must have first stopped continuously for 1000 ms inside the stop zone before crossing.

text:
The driver of any vehicle approaching a stop sign at the entrance to, or within, an intersection shall stop at a limit line, if marked, otherwise before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection.

If there is no limit line or crosswalk, the driver shall stop at the entrance to the intersecting roadway.
